The '''2026–27 season''' is the [[List of Chelsea F.C. seasons|121st season]] in the history of [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea Football Club]], and their 35th consecutive season in the [[Football in England|Premier League]] as well as their 38th consecutive season in the English top flight. In addition to the [[2026–27 Premier League|domestic league]], the club is also participating in the [[2026–27 FA Cup|FA Cup]] and the [[2026–27 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]].

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 7 December 2025, the club announced they would take part in the [[2026 Sydney Super Cup]] with matches against [[Western Sydney Wanderers FC|Western Sydney Wanderers]] and [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea FC and Chelsea FC Women head to Sydney for pre-season tour 2026 |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-fc-and-chelsea-fc-women-head-to-sydney-for-pre-season-tour-2026 |access-date=21 January 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=7 December 2025}}</ref> On 21 April 2026, it was announced that they would play [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] as part of the [[Hong Kong]] Football Festival 2026.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea to play in Asia in August against Serie A side |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-to-play-in-asia-in-august-against-serie-a-side |access-date=21 April 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=21 April 2026}}</ref> In May, a trip to [[Malaysia]] was added with a fixture against [[Johor Darul Ta'zim F.C.|Johor Darul Ta'zim]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Malaysia match added to Blues’ pre-season 2026 |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/malaysia-match-added-to-blues-pre-season-2026 |access-date=20 May 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=20 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Date change for match in Malaysia |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/date-change-for-match-in-malaysia |access-date=9 June 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=9 June 2026}}</ref> On 21 July, a home friendly against [[Real Sociedad]] was announced.<ref>{{cite news |title=Stamford Bridge to stage pre-season fixture against Spanish side Real Sociedad |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/stamford-bridge-to-stage-pre-season-fixture |access-date=21 July 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=21 July 2026}}</ref>

In the second round of the League Cup, Chelsea faced [[EFL League One|League One]] club [[Luton Town F.C.|Luton Town]] at home.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelseas-carabao-cup-second-round-opponents-revealed |title=Chelsea's Carabao Cup second round opponents revealed |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=10 August 2026 |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Date and kick-off time confirmed for Carabao Cup fixture against Luton |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/date-and-kick-off-time-confirmed-for-carabao-cup-fixture-against-luton |access-date=12 August 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=11 August 2026}}</ref> In the third round, Chelsea hosted fellow Premier League club [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-learn-potential-carabao-cup-third-round-opponents |title=Chelsea learn potential Carabao Cup third round opponents |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=27 August 2026 |access-date=28 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/date-and-kick-off-time-confirmed-for-chelsea-vs-leeds-united |title=Date and kick-off time confirmed for Chelsea vs Leeds United |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=28 August 2026 |access-date=28 August 2026}}</ref> In the fourth round, they will play [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] away.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-carabao-cup-fourth-round-opponents-sept-26 |title=Chelsea handed away tie in Carabao Cup fourth round |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=16 September 2026 |access-date=16 September 2026}}</ref>
